relation: one family over GTBase.orientations, for a simple graph G and an arbitrary Boolean relation D : rel G, each X81 / X82 helper by conversion: x8?_orientation_of D is orientation_of D (every arc joins adjacent vertices and every edge carries exactly one of its two arcs, D x y (+) D y x; so no loop and no digon); x8?_indegree D v is rel_indegree D v (the vertices u with D u v: incoming, not outgoing; a loop counts); x8?_proper_orientation D is proper_indegrees D (adjacent vertices have different indegrees, on an arbitrary D: no orientation is asserted, and a relation with a loop can be proper); x8?_proper_orientation_bound G k is proper_orientation_bound G k (one D with the three conjuncts in this order and every indegree at most k). Empty and edgeless hosts satisfy the bound at 0 through the empty relation; the bound is monotone in k with the same D. No orientation, loop, digon, nonemptiness or guard is added. Distinct and untouched: B16's diGraphType indeg (its owner keeps it), arc-set and selection indegrees (Alon-Tarsi at_indegree / at_spanning_orientation, P9 arcset_indeg) and Digraph XE2's split pair xe2_uses_only_edges / xe2_orients_edge.
summary: D11 proper-orientations, one family over the new public module `GTBase.orientations` (not re-exported by GTBase.base). For a simple graph G and an arbitrary Boolean relation `D : rel G`, Chromatic X81's and GTMisc X82's four helpers are, by conversion: `orientation_of D` (every arc joins adjacent vertices and every edge carries exactly one of its two arcs, `D x y (+) D y x`), `rel_indegree D v` (the vertices sending an arc to v: incoming, a loop counts), `proper_indegrees D` (adjacent vertices have different indegrees, for an arbitrary D: no orientation is asserted) and `proper_orientation_bound G k` (one D with the three conjuncts in this order and every indegree at most k). Binders, inferred G and every Arguments status are unchanged (baseline parity); no orientation, loop, digon, nonemptiness or guard is added.

API: arcs are edges, exclusivity, no loop, no digon, the empty relation's indegree, positive indegree, the edgeless and empty-host bound at 0, and monotonicity in k with the same D. Corners in the public-only client base/theories/examples/orientations.v: empty K_0 and edgeless K_1 at 0; on K_2 the single arc 0 -> 1 has indegrees 0 and 1 and gives bound 1 and 2 but not 0; both arcs form a digon; a loop at 0 is proper without being an orientation.

Frozen verbatim at the B29 pin e681570, eleven objects: the eight sources and three complete rows, X81's bipartite row (some C before every bipartite G, then some k with the bound and 2 * k <= Delta G + 2 * C), X82's outerplanar row (one C before every G under the unchanged forbidden-minor `x82_outerplanar`) and X101's planar row (one C before every G under the unchanged `wagner_planar`, through X101's import of X82). The guards and Delta / bipartite stay live, not migrated here. Three whole iff, all conversions; no earlier snapshot, so no Original. The reverse closure is X81.v, X82.v and X101.v alone (coqdep and lexical scans; no old proof header). Routes: X81 (chromatic-theory), X82 and X101 (graph-theory-misc); no Digraph source.
